name: print-social-stacked-gradient-cards-creative-gradients-post
title: Fanned stack of four gradient cards with a glossy red 'Creative Gradients' front card
whatItIs: A pale grey vertical post with tiny caps labels at the top, a fan of four rounded cards in teal, blue-violet, green and a large red-to-pink front card with a big white 'Creative Gradients' title, monospace 'VOL.01 2025' and short body, plus a handle and bookmark icon.
whatItMeans: Fresh and tactile; the fan makes gradients feel like collectable cards.
techniques: Fan cards behind a hero card to show variety.
Blur the gradient on the front card for depth.
Set a heavy white title with light body text.

vocabulary.definition: Layered cards offset to show edges.
A monospace label numbering a series.
